title: session crediting and playback sketch
content:
Context and quick elevator:
I want a low-friction way to 'credit' important user sessions (or parts thereof) for free replays / playback without changing our global billing model. The product goal is to increase activation and debugging velocity for new developers and key customers while retaining transparent unit economics for long-run cost tracking.

Problem statements / why this matters:
- New users hit cold-start costs and get frustrated by cost spikes when iterating on prompts. Result: churn during the first 1–2 days.
- Customer success & SEs want to replay a user's session exactly (including ephemeral system prompts / tool calls) to reproduce issues without incurring additional charges every time.
- Feature teams want a way to demo premium workflows (long context, multimodal) but avoid leaving a recurring billing footprint during sales cycles.

High-level idea (working name): Session Crediting + Playback
- Owners can mark entire sessions or specific message ranges as "credited" (one-off token budget attached). Credits allow:
  - unlimited (or X replays) playback for debugging/demo purposes without counting against customer invoice usage for a configurable period.
  - export for internal replay harnesses (QA, engineering).
- Complementary feature: Lightweight session snapshot that includes: user messages, system instructions, model + model-variant, token counts, KV cache checkpoint metadata (if available), and a hashed reference to attachments/tool calls.

User stories (rough):
- Developer (new user): "As a developer I want 1 free replay of my first 3 sessions so I can iterate on prompts without worrying about cost."
- SE / CSE: "As an SE I want to attach a demo credit to an account for 7 days so I can show the customer a full workflow in our environment during PoC calls."
- Support engineer: "As support I want to replay an exact session trace so I can reproduce a customer's bug, including the streaming behavior and tool call sequence, without creating charges."
- Security officer: "As security I want every credited replay to be logged and auditable (who granted, why, exported artifacts)."

Edge cases and constraints:
- Partial-crediting: if only a subset of messages are credited, how do we handle prefix caches (KV) that reference earlier tokens? Potential leakage of cost/semantics. Proposal: credits require that full prefix up to earliest credited message is included in snapshot; otherwise we forbid partial unless prefix is included.
- Model variant fallback: if the exact model variant is not available later, we should record a fallback policy: either block replay or choose a nearest-compatible variant and mark as "approximate replay".
- Data retention & privacy: snapshots may contain PII. Need opt-in or encryption and a clear retention TTL. Integrate with Private deployments (customer-managed keys) to store snapshots under customer KMS for on-prem customers.
- Abuse: large-scale free replays could be exploited. Rate-limit credits per account and require manager approval beyond thresholds.

Proposed data model snippet (conceptual, non-nested for notes):
- credit_id: autogenerated string
- grantor: name/email
- scope: [session_id | session_range (start_msg,end_msg) | snapshot_id]
- token_budget: integer or 'unlimited-within-ttl'
- ttl: expiry date
- audit_note: free text

Metrics / success criteria (experiment ideas):
- Activation delta: compare 7-day retention of new accounts given 3-session-credit vs control. Target +8–12% retention.
- Support TTR (time to reproduce) for bugs where a session is credited vs not: expect median TTR cut by 30–50%.
- Credit abuse rate: percentage of credits used > threshold of tokens or number of replays; target < 2% flagged for manual review.
- Cost ROC: compute monthly cost of credits as percent of incremental MRR influenced by credits; sanity cap at 0.5% of MRR initially.

UX flows (sketchy notes):
- Developer dashboard: 'My credited replays' card. Button: "Mark this session for replay" (confirm: reason, expiry).
- Admin console: bulk grant credits, set default new-account credit profile, view audit logs.
- Support panel: One-click create snapshot from live session, optionally scrub PII fields, then create credit and attach to replay ticket.
- Playback UI: show timeline with message-by-message token counts; play/pause streaming simulation; toggle 'exact model' vs 'approximate' indicator.

Implementation quick wins (MVP):
1) Server-side: metadata-only credits. Record credits in DB and make replay endpoint ignore billing for credited session IDs. No snapshot storage initially — rely on original session logs.
2) Replay CLI: internal-only tool for SEs to stream a recorded session for reproduction. Must respect credit flags.
3) Admin UI: simple page to grant credits and see usage.
4) Metric instrument: flag usage events and add a quick Grafana dashboard for credit consumption.

Longer-term (beta features):
- Full snapshot with compacted KV cache + deterministic seed so that replay can be run against newer runtime with reproducible output (hard).
- Allow customers to exchange credits for short-lived sandbox environments that can run replays with isolated compute.
- Integrate with Optimize suggestions: highlight sessions that would benefit from quantization / batch hints to reduce future replay cost.

Open questions / TODOs:
- Billing model decision: are credits 'invisible' (carrier-billed to Redwood) or charged to a central internal cost center? Need finance input. (Ping: @Mika Sato)
- Legal: retention and export compliance for snapshots with EU PII. Connect with privacy team for default TTL and encryption.
- SRE: what are cost/SLO implications for replay endpoints? Might need a separate capacity pool for replays.
- Product: what default credits for new accounts are defensible? 1st milestone: 3 free replays during first 14 days.

Next steps (immediate):
- Draft short experiment spec to test 3 free session credits for new signups (A/B). Owner: me. Deliverable: A/B spec + gating criteria by 2025-02-10.
- Quick spike: build internal replay CLI that honors credits. Owner: Noah. Target: 2-week spike.
- Slack thread: start discussion in #product-experiments with a short TL;DR and ask for finance/legal volunteers.

Notes to self: keep MVP small — billing exception + admin flow + internal replay CLI. Save the snapshot KV work for later. Put a clear opt-out for customers that don't want replays stored.

Random brainstorming bullets (unstructured):
- Could tie credits to referrals (give demo credits when an existing user invites a new one).
- For private deployments, credits could be purely local (no Redwood cost) — a configurable knob.
- Maybe expose 'demo-mode' embed link that replays a credited session for non-logged-in viewers with a time-limited token. Good for sales decks.

End of note.

(If someone stumbles on this: tag me or add to INF-2345 so I can formalize into a PRD.)
